title: Late Payment Policy
content: Rent is due on the first day of each month. A grace period of five days is allowed. After the grace period, a late fee may be applied based on lease terms.

title: Lease Renewal Policy
content: Tenants should be contacted 60 days before lease expiry. Renewal offers can be generated based on payment history, occupancy demand, and current market rent.

title: Move-in Checklist
content: Before move-in, tenants must complete identity verification, deposit payment, lease signature, and utility setup confirmation.

title: Property Booking Process
content: A lead can book a property after site visit, document verification, deposit payment, and digital agreement confirmation.

title: Maintenance SLA
content: Critical maintenance requests should be assigned immediately. High priority issues should be resolved within 48 hours whenever possible.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund eligibility depends on cancellation timing, booking terms, and whether the lease agreement has been signed.

title: Digital Signature Workflow
content: Lease agreements can be sent through a digital signature workflow. The lease status should be updated after all required parties sign.

title: Tenant Communication Policy
content: All tenant and lead communications should be logged in CRM activities, including calls, emails, SMS, WhatsApp, and site visits.
